name: DtlMode
meaning: DaffyTrainingLevel.mode, SetMode arg 0 (comment at 0x43eb56: 0 idle, 1 talking, 2 walking to the next help point; 0xff leaves it alone)

name: DTL_MODE_IDLE
meaning: SetMode case 0: shadow on, camera released, Wolf unfrozen, anim 0xb STAND1

name: DTL_MODE_TALK
meaning: case 1: Wolf frozen (msg 14), speech clock started

name: DTL_MODE_WALK
meaning: case 2: walk to the next help point, scripted camera
